title: 1Password credential provider freezes mRemoteNG and 1Password during CLI authorization (blocking op call on UI threa
author: herigson
body_snippet:
## Summary
When a connection uses the 1Password external credential provider and 1Password needs to authorize the CLI, both mRemoteNG and 1Password freeze. The 1Password authorization window appears blank and "Not Responding". After about 2 minutes `op` fails and both apps recover:

> 1Password read failed
> Error running op item get: [ERROR] ... error initializing client: authorization timeout

The only workaround I found is to quit 1Password from the tray and reopen it, then connect again. Aft...

comments.author: cremenescu
comments.snippet:
I checked this against the current `v1.78.2-dev` (25ef453a), and it holds there too:

- `OnePasswordCli.RunCommand` starts `op`, then calls `ReadToEnd()` on stdout, `ReadToEnd()` on stderr and `WaitForExit()`, with no timeout.
- It is called synchronously from `RdpProtocol.SetCredentials()`, `RdpProtocol.SetRdGateway()` and `PuttyBase.Connect()`, all on the UI thread, so mRemoteNG stops answering window messages until `op` returns. If 1Password's authorization prompt waits on the calling app, as...
